claim_ceiling: A complete calibration and fourteen-row execution-freeze proposal is prepared for independent review. It does not authorize execution or assign robustness, descendant significance, or a new E-REPRO claim.

classifier_versioning_and_provenance.permanent_limitation: No separate pre-correction source blob was committed. The preliminary predicate and outcome are reconstructed explicitly against the immutable registered arrays.
classifier_versioning_and_provenance.permanent_process_rule: every future classifier or decision-rule implementation must be committed and hash-bound before it evaluates scientific output

convergence_threshold_provenance.comparison: observed order must be strictly greater than the candidate threshold
convergence_threshold_provenance.rounding_rule: reserve a quarter-order empirical margin, round downward to a half order, and cap at the preregistered 1.5 second-order acceptance floor

deterministic_outcome_logic.controlled_row_failure_rule: a row with complete classifiable evidence may fail a frozen robustness threshold and contribute to CONDITIONAL_ROBUST; a row lacking classifiable evidence contributes to NUMERICALLY_BLOCKED

descendant_significance_decision_rules.DESCENDANTS_DYNAMICALLY_NECESSARY_QUANTI: the structural noninvariance/source residual is resolved while all registered R_PERP and F_EXCHANGE_PERP values remain below 0.1
descendant_significance_decision_rules.DESCENDANT_DOMINATED_REGIME: resolved evidence has F_EXCHANGE_PERP>=0.5 or any registered R_PERP_OBSERVABLE>=0.5
descendant_significance_decision_rules.INTERMEDIATE_DESCENDANT_CONTRIBUTION: resolved evidence crosses a 0.1 materiality gate but neither dominated gate
descendant_significance_decision_rules.NO_SIGNIFICANCE_CLASS_WHEN_BLOCKED: no descendant-significance class is assigned when required numerical evidence is blocked or outside the model domain

evaluation_order: verify custody and complete run matrix
verify numerical evidence availability and admissibility for every full-model row
apply model-domain criteria without dropping rows
classify robustness across all admitted rows
apply sensitivity analysis and bounded claim ceiling

robustness_decision_rules.BROADLY_ROBUST: every full-model scientific row meets every frozen numerical-quality and control criterion and the conclusion is not threshold-sensitive
robustness_decision_rules.CONDITIONALLY_ROBUST: a nonempty explicitly listed preregistered subdomain meets every criterion but the full frozen matrix does not
robustness_decision_rules.MODEL_DOMAIN_LIMITED: one or more preregistered rows exit the admitted classical model domain; the row remains reported
robustness_decision_rules.NUMERICALLY_BLOCKED: one or more required rows lack controlled solver, residual, or convergence evidence
robustness_decision_rules.THRESHOLD_SENSITIVE: the robustness or descendant-significance conclusion changes across the frozen 0.05, 0.1, 0.2 sensitivity values

deterministic_outcome_logic.separation_rule: robustness status and descendant-significance status are independent fields; neither overwrites the other

environment_identity.canonical_serialization: sorted-key UTF-8 NFC JSON with LF and finite numbers only

execution_consumer_contract.execution_order_source: the exact record order in the hash-bound matrix
execution_consumer_contract.unknown_missing_or_duplicate_record_beha: refuse execution and preserve the custody failure

failure_and_rerun_semantics.rerun_allowed_only_for: byte-identical reproduction under the same frozen identity, or a separately authorized versioned repair that cannot overwrite v1 evidence
failure_and_rerun_semantics.threshold_relaxation: forbidden; preserve the result and rotate to a versioned repair review

fixed_structural_numerical_gates.deterministic_duplicate_rule: byte-identical registered numerical payloads under the bound environment

observable_and_energy_freeze.energy_acceptance: bounded over duration, finest error no larger than coarsest, and frozen three-level order threshold passed

measurement_contract.C_PERP_SOURCE_NORM: max_t sqrt(||J2||_2^2+||J3||_2^2) in the forced comparator
measurement_contract.F_EXCHANGE_PERP: (|X2|+|X3|)/(|X_longitudinal|+|X2|+|X3|+epsilon_exchange_floor) using the maximum absolute cumulative exchanges
measurement_contract.R_PERP_OBSERVABLE: max_t ||O_full-O_comparator||_2/(max_t ||O_full||_2+epsilon_observable_floor), reported separately for every registered O
measurement_contract.T_DIVERGENCE: first stored time at which the corresponding pointwise-in-time R_perp,O reaches delta_O; RIGHT_CENSORED_AT_DURATION if absent
measurement_contract.full_vs_comparator_alignment: same parent row, grid, time samples, duration, and solver settings
measurement_contract.signed_total_energy_role: physical conservation and exchange diagnostic only
measurement_contract.spatial_constraint_norm: max_x absolute value, with L2 also reported
measurement_contract.time_aggregation_for_energy_changes: maximum absolute departure from the row's initial value
measurement_contract.time_aggregation_for_exchange: maximum absolute cumulative registered exchange over the common duration
measurement_contract.time_aggregation_for_residuals: maximum over every stored time sample

descendant_observables.definition: registered spinor-to-phi2 exchange integral with the accepted sign convention
registered spinor-to-phi3 exchange integral with the accepted sign convention
sqrt(|Box(phi2)-J2|^2+|Box(phi3)-J3|^2) evaluated for the forced truncation

observable_and_energy_freeze.signed_total_energy_role: physical conservation and exchange diagnostic only

proposed_numerical_parameter_freeze.selection_rule: uniform across all fourteen rows; primary uses the finest accepted pilot grid, finest accepted pilot timestep, tightest accepted pilot tolerance, accepted duration, and accepted cap

scientific_materiality_freeze.resolved_above_floor_rule: signal must exceed ten times its independently calibrated numerical floor
scientific_materiality_freeze.source: accepted guardrail v1; unchanged by pilot or calibration
